question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

He was __appointed__ as the Manager.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dismissed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"appointed"** means officially assigning someone to a position or role. (नियुक्त किया गया)

 
 
• **Example:** She was appointed as the team leader for the upcoming project.
 
 
 
• **"Dismissed"** refers to officially removing someone from a position or role, often due to unsatisfactory performance or redundancy. (पदच्युत)
 
 
• **Example:** The employee was dismissed for failing to meet company standards.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'appointed'** is **'dismissed'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Dismissed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Disordered** (अव्यवस्थित): Lacking order or organization.

 
 
• **Example:** His desk was so disordered that he couldn't find the important documents.
 
 
 
• **Assigned** (सौंपी गई): Designated or allocated for a specific role or task.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher assigned homework to the students to complete over the weekend.
 
 
 
• **Disappointed** (निराश): Feeling sadness or displeasure due to unfulfilled hopes or expectations.
 
 
• **Example:** He was disappointed when his team lost the match.
 
 

1dd:Tbef,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
